title: geranium napuligerum f. lobulatum
intro: Geranium napuligerum f. lobulatum, commonly known as the Mountain Geranium, is a flowering plant species in the family Geraniaceae. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving blood circulation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Geranium include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluids from the body, and its antispasmodic properties, which can help to relieve muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Geranium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
